svg.aria-label: Tribute to John McCarthy, who coined the term artificial intelligence
svg.title: Tribute to John McCarthy, who coined the term artificial intelligence
svg.text: Named the field “artificial intelligence” (Dartmouth, 1955) · created Lisp (1958)
pioneered time-sharing and garbage collection · Turing Award 1971
That's why the numbers below come from logs and APIs, not memory.
